temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan admits he has been hiding something from Christian: he is in some trouble and did not know how to tell him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is hiding something important from him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Christian's suspicion is confirmed and becomes more specific: Jonathan has been hiding that he is in trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is in some kind of trouble and has been keeping it from him.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To get Jonathan to explain what is going on and uncover the truth.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan is reluctant to drag Christian into the situation, but admits he could use support and resources to get out of a complicated mess.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is in trouble and has been hiding it; the details are still unclear.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Christian learns the trouble is complicated and that Jonathan is willing to accept help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan needs support and resources, and Christian can help him face the situation.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To offer help and support Jonathan through the trouble.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says he cannot be sure, but he might have gotten involved with the wrong people, while insisting he did not do anything illegal himself.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is in a complicated trouble and needs help; the nature of the trouble is still unclear.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Christian now believes Jonathan's trouble is likely related to criminal activity or dangerous people, though Jonathan claims he himself is not guilty.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan's trouble is probably tied to some kind of criminal activity or wrong people, and Jonathan may be entangled even if he says he did nothing illegal.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To investigate the matter discreetly without alarming Jonathan.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian's investigation reveals that Jonathan is being framed, and he tells Jonathan that someone is trying to set him up.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan's trouble may involve criminal activity or wrong people; Jonathan claims he did not do anything illegal.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Christian shifts from suspecting possible involvement to believing Jonathan is the victim of a frame-up.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is innocent and is being framed; Christian needs to gather evidence to clear his name.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To gather evidence to prove Jonathan's innocence.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian found out who is behind the frame-up: it is someone close to both him and Jonathan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is being framed by an unknown person, and Christian has leads but not the culprit.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Christian identifies the real culprit as a trusted mutual acquaintance, adding a sense of betrayal.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Someone close to both of them is responsible for framing Jonathan; this is a betrayal by a trusted person.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront the real culprit and bring them to justice.
